title: Jump to a Master Entity Using a Keyboard Shortcut

chapters.title: Applying the Shortcut to Referenced Fields

features.name: Jump to Master Entity with Keyboard Shortcut
features.description: Users can hold Control-Alt-Down to jump directly to a master entity from any referenced field in Business Central, such as navigating from a sales line to the item card or customer master.

quotes.text: easily jump to a Master entity with a keyboard shortcut when you work with data in business Central
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the core feature being demonstrated - a keyboard shortcut for navigating to master entities.

quotes.text: to go directly to the item I've selected here I can hold down the key control and ALT and then choose the down arrow
quotes.why_it_matters: Provides the exact keyboard combination (Control-Alt-Down) needed to execute the master entity jump.

quotes.text: Control Alt down to jump directly to the item you'll see the item card opening here for this specific product
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the shortcut working in practice, showing the immediate result of navigating to the item card.

quotes.text: this works for any referenced field you can jump to a customer you can jump to items and so on this works anywhere in
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the broad applicability of the shortcut across all referenced fields and entities throughout the system.
